newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: PRESS DIGEST - CZECH REPUBLIC - SEPT 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - CZECH REPUBLIC - SEPT 17.

text.p: HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - The head of investment company Motoinvest said members of the Civic Democratic Alliance (ODA), a junior partner in the governing coalition, were involved in the fall of Kreditni Banka Plzen a.s. last month.
- The Czech trade deficit could reach 163 billion crowns this year, the Czech Statistical Office (CSU) said.
- IPB Banka a.s signed an agreement for a five year 115 million mark syndictaed loan lead managed by Bayerische Landesbank.
- The Czech crown remained strong on Monday against its dollar/mark basket, rising to 4.3 percent above parity.
MLADA FRONTA DNES - July retail sales rose a real 5.7 percent in July.

- The government recognises the problems caused to business of high Czech interest rates, Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus said. But, added, Klaus, high interest rates were likely to remian for some time in order to fight inflation.
- Klaus, an avowed free marketeer, promised more state money to help exports next year.
